Thick lines: exterior walls. Thin gray: knee walls (5 ft). Blue: windows.
Dashed: clipped-ceiling strips. West strip: racks. East strip: bookshelves.
Sheet A.4, north up, roughly to scale. Overall 42'6" wide.
Arrow: passage across from R1, east through the small attic to the entry in the wall to the old house attic.
R1 to R5: rack openings behind the west clipped strip. 6: same-size opening, no rack.
B1 to B5 bookshelves. SK: sink with RO tap, flush to the south wall of its space; amber dot: leak sensor.
Network
1 R1: main network stack and fiber distribution; fiber in from the garage modem entry.
2 UniFi AP, ceiling, east office. 3 UniFi AP, wall, west office east wall, south of the door.
4 Floor Ethernet jack, east edge of the west clipped strip, across from R2.
5 Floor Ethernet jack, west edge of the east clipped strip, across from B1.
6 Wall Ethernet jack, west office south wall, east of the windows.
7 PoE presence sensor, wall, west office east wall, north of the door, facing west.
8 PoE presence sensor, same wall and spot, east office side, facing east.
9, 10 PoE presence sensors, wall, east office north wall, one each side of the windows.
11, 12 PoE presence sensors, wall, east office south wall, one each side of the window.
13 PoE presence sensor, wall, south wall at the top of the stairs, facing north down the stairs.
Power
A 20A duplex outlet inside R2. B 20A duplex outlet inside R4. E Spare 20A home run, boxed in R3 (dashed).
C, D Floor power outlets, about 2.5 ft south of floor Ethernet jacks 4 and 5.
P1 to P5 West office wall outlets: north wall (2), west wall, south jog wall, south wall by the door.
P6 to P12 East office wall outlets: north wall (2), west knee wall, clipped strip edges (2), south wall (2).
P13, P14 Small attic, north and south ends. P15 Old house attic side of the wall, just north of the doorway.
P16 Beside S7. P17 Just north of S4, above the sink. Both GFCI, near the sink (SK).
H1 to H5 High outlets near window tops for smart blinds: W office south (2), E office north (2), E office south (1).
Lighting (proposed): Govee dimmable ceiling lights, Inovelli White Series switches
L1, L2 West office, one in each half, level. S1 at the top of the stairs, S2 by the office door (3-way pair).
L3, L4, L5 East office, north, middle and south. S3 on the east side of the shared door.
L6 Small attic. S4 in the east office, just north of the attic passage.
L7 West office closet. S5 on the office wall beside the closet.
L8 Old house attic. S6 on the small attic side of the entry, just north of it.
L9 Short track light in the open space north of S4. S7 at the north end of that space.
Switches in smart bulb mode: lights keep constant power, switch dims them over Matter or Home Assistant.
S8 Stair riser lights, top of the stairs beside S1. Pairs with S3 at the bottom, on the second floor.
S9 Stair wall lights (L33, L34 on the 2nd floor), top of the stairs. Pairs with S15 at the bottom.
S10 L35 ceiling light, west stair second leg (2nd floor), top of the stairs. Pairs with S17 at the bottom.
Circuits (proposed)
C1 20A dedicated: A (R2 rack).
C2 20A dedicated: B (R4 rack).
C3 20A west office: P1 to P5, H1, H2.
C4 20A east office desks: C, D, P8, P9, P10.
C5 20A east office perimeter: P6, P7, P11, P12, H3, H4, H5.
C6 20A sink and attics: P16, P17 (GFCI), P13, P14, P15. Dual AFCI/GFCI breaker.
C7 15A lighting: L1 to L9.
C8 20A spare home run E to a box in R3, reachable for R1, R3 or R5 later.
AFCI breakers on C3 to C8 per code; confirm racks C1, C2 with the electrician and inspector.
Smoke alarm (added from sheet A.4)
SD1 Smoke alarm, west office ceiling.
Hardwired, interconnected, battery backup (A.2 note 9); on a lighting circuit, confirm with electrician.
